method: Six alternating process pairs, GOMAXPROCS=1; one warmup then eight uncached load/parse/check/verified-MIR iterations per corpus and process. Forced GC before timing; normal GC within. Go cumulative allocations, not peak/RSS or child allocations. Setup, lock creation, process startup, Go compilation and cache serialization excluded. Same unlabeled .fy bytes across revisions; manifests use each compiler's exact language pin. Scanner+SDK control is frontend-only. Synthetic 64-call corpus additionally measures ordinary C/native builds in both profiles, artifact bytes, in-memory package-cache bytes with verified warm hits; separate existing private /Z7 /DEBUG:FULL probes capture PDB. Ambient OS/tool caches; source spans and random MSVC temporary paths may affect metadata. Sizes are observations, not filtered by equality. No runtime-speed, Linux, full application or disk-cache/fymap conclusion.
